title: Define a minimum security, privacy and audit baseline
requirements:
- Require policy-based access beyond role-based control
- Describe security operations and incident response as a standing, recurrently funded function
- Distinguish controls that mature over time from properties required from initial operation
- State minimum key lifecycle states a national trust infrastructure must manage
- Provide a risk-proportionate supplier assurance baseline countries can evaluate against
- State the monoculture trade-off of consolidation and its design consequences, e.g. no mandated single reference implementation, degraded operation
- Carry security-by-design into phases, procurement, financing and operations
- Extend 3.4.4 to cover security operations, vulnerability management, continuity and disaster recovery, privacy incidents and supplier performance
